topic: How to spot a scam: guaranteed high returns, pressure to act fast, and asking you to keep it secret.

episode.title: Coin & Kash: Three Scam Warning Signs

shots.narration: That tempting money offer might hide three scam warning signs.
shots.scene: Bright modern cafe, vertical 9:16, clean 3D animation; blank gold envelope beside Kash's cup, no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash reaches toward the glittering envelope.
shots.mood: Tempting golden glow with a faint red shadow.

shots.narration: Coin helps Kash examine the offer before handing over money.
shots.scene: Cafe tabletop with a blank gold envelope and a small stack of coins, no text or markings.
shots.action: Coin places a tiny magnifying glass over the envelope.
shots.mood: Friendly curiosity with bright turquoise accents.

shots.narration: [surprised] Guaranteed high returns? That's the first warning sign.
shots.scene: Cafe table with an imaginary oversized coin pile beneath a transparent dome, no text or markings.
shots.action: Coin points toward the oversized pile beneath the dome.
shots.mood: Exaggerated golden sparkle edged with warning-red light.

shots.narration: Next, the offer pressures Kash to act fast.
shots.scene: Cafe table with the gold envelope beside a large hourglass, no text or numerals.
shots.action: Kash hurriedly slides her coin stack toward the envelope.
shots.mood: Tense orange lighting and nearly empty hourglass.

shots.narration: Coin spots the second warning sign: that hurry.
shots.scene: Close view of the cafe tabletop, hourglass and gold envelope visible, no text.
shots.action: Coin raises one palm between Kash's hand and the envelope.
shots.mood: Calm blue light interrupts the orange tension.

shots.narration: [whispers] Then comes, 'Keep it secret.' That's warning sign three.
shots.scene: Cafe table with a floating closed padlock beside a simple mouth-shaped symbol, no letters or text.
shots.action: Coin points toward the closed padlock.
shots.mood: Secretive purple shadows with a clear red warning glow.

shots.narration: Guaranteed high returns, hurry, secrecy: Kash recognizes the warning signs.
shots.scene: Cafe table beneath three floating symbols: domed coin pile, hourglass, and locked mouth, no text.
shots.action: Kash pulls her coin stack back toward herself.
shots.mood: Relieved daylight returns as the red glow fades.

shots.narration: Today, check a money offer for these three warning signs.
shots.scene: Bright cafe table with Kash's open notebook showing only three simple pictograms, no writing.
shots.action: Kash taps the three warning pictograms in her notebook.

shots.narration: [excited] Next time, can you spot the warning signs with us?
shots.scene: Bright cafe table with three blank envelopes and the closed notebook, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Coin fans out the three blank envelopes toward the viewer.
shots.mood: Playful anticipation with cheerful gold and turquoise colours.

episode.endHook: Next episode: Coin and Kash practice spotting the warning signs together.
episode.description: Coin helps Kash spot three scam warning signs: guaranteed high returns, pressure to act fast, and demands for secrecy. General money education with one simple action to try today.
